snippet.title: He Who Watches - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A first person puzzle game about walking on walls, manipulating gravity, and discovering secrets. Delve deep into a labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking the god at the centre of it all.

👁️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1070500/He_Who_Watches/
👁️ Website: https://hewhowatches.com/
